title: ICT 2024 Mentorship - Execution Rules & Invalidation Checklists

rules.name: 10:00 AM New York Gate Filter
rules.condition: Evaluate the 09:30 AM cash open relative to the 09:00 - 09:30 AM pre-market opening candle range.
rules.action: If the 09:30 AM open price is contained inside the 09:00 - 09:30 AM range, QUARANTINE all executions until 10:00:00 AM EST.
rules.rationale: Prevents whipsaw losses during opening equilibrium traps.

rules.name: Candle Body Market Structure Shift (MSS)
rules.condition: Price must close with a full candle body across the key swing point on the 5-minute chart.
rules.invalidation: If price only wicks through a swing point without closing beyond it, the shift is FALSE (Turtle Soup). Reject setup immediately.
rules.quote: The body tells the truth, the wick lies.

rules.name: 50% Consequent Encroachment (C.E.) Respect
rules.condition: Fair Value Gaps (SIBI/BISI) have a sensitive 50% midpoint (Consequent Encroachment).

invalidation.bearish_sibi: Subsequent candle bodies MUST NOT close above the 50% C.E. level.
invalidation.bullish_bisi: Subsequent candle bodies MUST NOT close below the 50% C.E. level.

rules.rationale: Body closure through 50% C.E. indicates institutional failure to defend the imbalance.

rules.name: Premium vs Discount Quadrant Filter
rules.condition: Divide the session reference range into Equilibrium (50%), Premium (upper 50%), and Discount (lower 50%).
rules: BUYS (Longs) are strictly permitted ONLY in the Discount quadrant.
SELLS (Shorts) are strictly permitted ONLY in the Premium quadrant.
rules.rationale: Institutions accumulate cheap assets and distribute expensive assets. Never sell in discount or buy in premium.

rules.name: Double Tap Order Execution & Defensive Shields

Center_Mass.shield: When hit, immediately advance stop loss to Breakeven + 2 ticks buffer. The trade is now risk-free.

Head_Shot.trail: Trail stop loss behind successive 5m Fair Value Gap Consequent Encroachments until full 3.0R expansion completes.
